en-US.longDescription:
HexEdit is powerful hexadecimal editor with following features:
- MDI interface
- Data Inspector
- Calculator
- File Compare
- Memory Dumper
- Disk Dumper
- Data interpreter and analyzer

Free to use for private, educational and non-commercial purposes. For other usage you should buy commercial license.
en-US.name: MiTeC HexEdit
